6. Fourth-twelfth defendants, also, laid a separate written statement, with similar averments as averred in written statement filed by third defendants except the stand not adopted by Third defendants but assumed by them that plaintiff is not the daughter of Kala Chand Basak and she is the daughter of one Krishna Chandra Basak who died leaving behind 3 sons who left for India in the year 1950. Defendants are in possession of suit property long before 1960. Under threat and coercion plaintiff's husband realised some money from some of defendants posing himself to be the owner of suit property without issuing any Rent Receipts and some of defendants paid money under mistaken belief that plaintiff's husband Dulal Chandra Basak was owner of suit property. Defendants became aware that suit property vested in Government as vested property and they applied for lease of suit property. Defendants became aware of a fraudulent suit and ex parte decree obtained by plaintiff and they laid Title Suit No. 306 of 1978 in the Sixth Court of Munsif, Dhaka for cancellation of decree. 

 49. Fourth-twelfth-defendants went further than third-defendant Assistant Custodian of Enemy Property when they introduced a case that plaintiff is not the daughter of Kala Chand Basak and she is daughter of Krishna Chandra Basal who died leaving behind three sons As legal heirs and all of them left the then Pakistan in 1950 for India and became Indian Nationals.
